patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Medusa and Salesforce Commerce Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Medusa and Salesforce Commerce Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Medusa only if your buying job matches “Headless JS commerce — MIT OSS free; Cloud Develop $29, Launch $99 highlighted, Scale $299” rather than Salesforce Commerce Cloud's shape. Choose Salesforce Commerce Cloud only if your buying job matches “Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; ” rather than Medusa's shape. Workflow advantage: Medusa leans shared coverage; Salesforce Commerce Cloud leans wholesale-b2b, catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Medusa and Salesforce Commerce Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Medusa is Headless JS commerce — MIT OSS free; Cloud Develop $29, Launch $99 highlighted, Scale $299, Enterprise custom. No GMV tax.; Salesforce Commerce Cloud is Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; enterprise SaaS landscape, not an SMB Shopify subs.
- Company-size focus: Medusa (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Salesforce Commerce Cloud (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Medusa-leaning — vs Salesforce Commerce Cloud-leaning wholesale-b2b, catalog-management.
- Researched limits: Medusa — Headless means you still build or buy the storefront UX; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet.

Limitations — Medusa: Headless means you still build or buy the storefront UX; Not a WordPress-native plugin path (see WooCommerce); Salesforce Commerce Cloud: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Implementation is a multi-month SI programme, not a weekend theme install.

Poor-fit cases: Medusa is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Headless means you still build or buy the storefront UX · Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet · Avoid Medusa if you actually need Salesforce Commerce Cloud's motion (Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent qu)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
